title: Create Podio API Catalog JSON
description: Create comprehensive JSON file with Podio API endpoints organized by groups. JSON file must include all major API groups (items, apps, users, tasks, etc.), each endpoint has: id, method, path, params, rate limits, summary. File must be valid JSON and placed in appropriate location (data/ or config/).
details: Sprint 1 - API Catalog Tools. This catalog serves as the reference for all API browsing tools.
testStrategy: Validate JSON structure, verify all required fields exist, check file location is correct.
